g.text: NOTE 1: One U2D2 is assigned to exactly one physical bus. No second bus is implied from UB1.

g.text: NOTE 2: Mating connectors, contacts, cable gauge, strain relief, and pin-orientation inspection remain open.

g.text: NOTE 3: Standard fully populated 3-pin TTL cables carry VDD and would parallel protected branches. Release a data-only harness/breakout and pass continuity plus no-backfeed tests.
